title: Tracecat 1.3.0-alpha.5
body_markdown:
## Security


- security(mcp): Revoke MCP access when any granted org removes a user ([#3962](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3962) )
- security(deps): Patch Next.js image RCE, DOMPurify, OTel, virtualenv ([#3965](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3965) )
- security(api): Add AES-256-GCM option for database encryption ([#3983](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3983) )


## Case management


- fix(cases): Keep search focused while results load ([#3978](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3978) )
- fix(cases): Show a neutral empty state when case search times out ([#3980](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3980) )
- perf(cases): Speed up case text search with stored search vectors ([#3998](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3998) )
- perf(cases): Match case search typos through stored word lists ([#4004](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4004) )
- fix(infra+cases): Support IBM Cloud's ibm_extension schema ([#4014](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4014) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Enforce the shared MCP tool discovery timeout ([#3744](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3744) )
- feat(agents): Steer a running turn from chat ([#3944](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3944) )
- feat(agents): Add session command table and store ([#3961](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3961) )
- feat(agents+ui): Restore builder chat tab on agent presets ([#3963](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3963) )
- feat(agents): List pending messages and expose withdraw to UI extensions ([#3970](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3970) )
- fix(agents): Show missing provider credentials as a chat error ([#3975](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3975) )
- fix(agents): Route managed OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM models ([#3981](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3981) )
- feat(agents): Run stdio MCP servers through a pluggable runner ([#3986](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3986) )
- feat(agents): Run Slack, comment and MCP agents on the selected backend ([#3990](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3990) )
- feat(agents): Gate non-default agent backends by entitlement ([#3991](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3991) )
- feat(agents): Share the session sink and add caller-owned turn results ([#3992](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3992) )
- refactor(agents): Drop the agent-runtime feature flag ([#3993](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3993) )


## Core actions


- revert(actions): Deduplicate by whole item when keys is empty ([#3966](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3966) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add Spur Context API templates ([#3997](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3997) )
- feat(integrations): Expand Fleet REST API coverage ([#3999](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3999) )


## Engine


- feat(engine): Execute Git sync with durable background receipts ([#3740](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3740) )


## API


- fix(api): Guard workspace Git writes against branch races ([#3737](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3737) )
- refactor(api): Separate Git sync preparation from import commits ([#3738](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3738) )
- feat(api): Preserve reviewed Git sync snapshots and stale guards ([#3739](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3739) )
- feat(api): Expose durable Git sync operations and paginated diffs ([#3741](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3741) )
- fix(api): Map named unique violations and sanitize database errors ([#3911](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3911) )
- fix(api): Preserve action descriptions in workflow definitions ([#3928](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3928) )
- feat(api+ui): Require security keys and passkeys for sign-in ([#3941](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3941) )
- fix(api+ui): Require Publish before first workflow Git push ([#3950](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3950) )
- feat(api): Configure managed resources source and list its tags ([#4009](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4009) )
- fix(api): Release the database session before streaming chat events ([#4013](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4013) )


## User interface


- feat(ui): Review and resume background Git sync operations ([#3742](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3742) )
- feat(ui): Move workflow published time into row timestamps ([#3976](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3976) )
- refactor(ui): Standardize create and delete button labels ([#3979](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3979) )


## Infrastructure


- infra: Run the Git sync background worker ([#3708](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3708) )
- fix(infra): Reparent the WebAuthn MFA migration onto the command table ([#3973](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3973) )
- docs(infra): Add self-hosting support checklist page ([#3974](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3974) )
- refactor(infra): Use transaction-scoped advisory locks ([#4003](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4003) )
- feat(infra): Add managed resource side tables ([#4008](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4008) )


## Observability


- fix(logging): Stop logging secret ciphertext in workflow validation ([#3988](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3988) )
- fix(logging): Stop logging decrypted GitHub and GitLab credentials ([#3989](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3989) )


## Dependencies


- build(deps): Bump temporalio to 1.34.0 ([#3996](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3996) )
- build(deps): Pin temporalio to 1.32.0 ([#4001](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4001) )
- build(deps): Bump authlib, litellm, pymongo and others for advisories ([#4002](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4002) )


**Full changelog** :[1.3.0-alpha.4...1.3.0-alpha.5](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.3.0-alpha.4...1.3.0-alpha.5)
